records.title: 10-K
records.text: For the year ended December 31, 2024, consolidated revenue was $7.7 billion, an increase of $61.4 million or 0.8%, as compared to the prior year.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Bookings increased 7.3% over the prior year to $7.7 billion for the year ended December 31, 2024.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Organic revenue remained flat due to increases of 8.2%, 2.6%, 2.4%, and 1.4% in our Engineered Products, Clean Energy & Fueling, Imaging & Identification, and Pumps & Process Solutions segments, respectively, offset by the Climate & Sustainability Technologies segment which declined 11.2%.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The total number of shares ultimately repurchased under the ASR Program was based on the volume-weighted average share price of Dover's common stock during the calculation period of the accelerated share repurchase program, less a discount, which was $174.26 over the term of the ASR Program.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Cash flow from operating activities for the year ended December 31, 2024 decreased by $131.7 million compared to 2023.
